items.title: Vivek Ramaswamy nearly drops a kid on stage: 'Big guy!'
items.summary: At a Trump rally in Vandalia, Ohio, gubernatorial candidate Vivek Ramaswamy invited a 10-year-old onstage, promised 'I'll pick you up', and nearly dropped him before saying 'Whoa! Big guy!'. The clip spread across X overnight and into Sunday, with people on both sides of the aisle comparing it to Dukakis in the tank and the Howard Dean scream. Commenters joked it was 'what happens when a culture venerates the math olympiad over the jock.'
items.author: @Acyn
